description: This Java class implements data access operations for CustomerOptionValue entities, including retrieving by store, ID, and code using Querydsl queries.

classes.name: CustomerOptionValueDaoImpl
classes.description: Implementation of data access object for CustomerOptionValue entities, providing methods to list and retrieve customer option values based on store, ID, and code.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves a list of CustomerOptionValue entities associated with a specific MerchantStore and Language, using left joins and filtering by store ID and language ID.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Fetches a CustomerOptionValue entity by its ID, including associated descriptions and merchant store.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a CustomerOptionValue entity by its code within a specific MerchantStore.
